_about: Public-domain Francis Wayland (1796-1865, Baptist, president of Brown University) for the Word Hoard: The Elements of Moral Science (1835), Political Economy (1837), Intellectual Philosophy (1854), The Limitations of Human Responsibility (1838), University Sermons (1849), Notes on Baptist Churches (1857), Sermons to the Churches (1859), Salvation by Christ (1859), Letters on the Ministry (1863), the Memoir of Adoniram Judson (2 vols, 1853) and Domestic Slavery Considered as a Scriptural Institution (1845, his published correspondence with Richard Fuller, who argued the other side), raw Internet Archive OCR. Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 15 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
